feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 June 2026 4:42pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 28 June 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind in places at first.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low to the south of Iceland, with the next lows soon moving into the middle of the North Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5 at first, but 5 or 6 in the east of the area, then veering West or Southwest 4 or 5 in all waters tonight. Backing South or Southwest 4 occasionally 5 later tomorrow morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 4 occasionally 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the west of the area overnight into Tuesday, then decreasing 3 or 4 in all waters on Tuesday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.
